name: pi-media-transcribe
description: Local-first transcription to structured Markdown notes: transcribe YouTube, podcasts and meetings offline with Whisper or Qwen3-ASR, then optionally have an LLM proofread, segment, summarize and file into any notes folder or Obsidian vault.
